enchantments.tooltip: Feather Falling: This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Riposte +4: This item enchants its user with incredible awareness and speed, granting a +4 Insight bonus to AC and to Saves.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
